turns.q: What payment methods do you accept for an order?
turns.replyTail:
On the US store you can pay with:

Most major credit cards, including American Express
Apple Pay
Google Pay
PayPal
Shop Pay

Some options may not show at checkout, depending on your location and your payment platform's settings. Afterpay is only offered in Australia and New Zealand, and Klarna only in the UK and Europe, so neither is available on the US store. An order can only be paid with one method, so you can't split it across two cards or between a card and PayPal.
